skills.name: Where Trust Leads Me!
skills.summary: Deal Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG). Gain Divergent for 20s. Divergent - The next time Sigrika obtains a Rune, she additionally obtains a Rune of the opposite type and removes Divergent. - When Sigrika holds Divergent and Convergent at the same time, Convergent takes priority. - When Sigrika holds 100 points of Full Stop, Divergent doesn't take effect.

skills.name: Within Infinity's Embrace
skills.summary: Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes - Hold Normal Attack to consume two Runes and cast Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes, dealing Aero DMG. Based on the types of the Runes consumed, Sigrika gains the following effects: - When consuming Rune: Trust and Rune: Answer, this skill gains the effect of Runic Outburst. - When consuming two Runes: Trust, this skill gains the effect of Runic Chain Whip. - When consuming two Runes: Answer, this skill gains the effect of Runic Soliskin. - W…

skills.name: Tune Break
skills.summary: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.

skills.name: True Names Invoked
skills.summary: Casting Intro Skill - Solsworn Etymology grants Convergent for 20s. Convergent - The next time Sigrika obtains a Rune, she additionally obtains a Rune of the same type and removes Convergent. - When Sigrika holds Divergent and Convergent at the same time, Convergent takes priority. - When Sigrika holds 100 points of Full Stop, Convergent doesn't take effect.

skills.name: True Names Aligned
skills.summary: When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Sigrika gains a stack of Blessing of Runes, up to 6 stacks. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once. This effect resets upon a lineup change. Blessing of Runes - Each stack of Blessing of Runes grants the active Resonator in the team 3% Aero DMG Bonus and 3% Echo Skill DMG Bonus. - When Blessing of Runes reaches 6 stacks. skills.name: In This Very Moment
skills.summary: Attack the target, deal Aero DMG equal to 795% of Sigrika's ATK. Gain 2 stacks of Encapsulated for 30s. Encapsulated - When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skills, Stagnate the target and consume 1 stacks of Encapsulated. Encapsulated stacks up to 2 times. All stacks of Encapsulated are removed when Sigrika is removed from the lineup.
